title: Tech Note: 4D Mobile Exchange Records using Collection

historical_commentary.text: This demonstrates data exchange between 4D and Wakanda Enterprise (the JS backend underpinning 4D Mobile) using collections converted from entity selections; both 4D Mobile and Wakanda Enterprise Studio have been discontinued, making the demo's tooling obsolete, though the general concept of converting entity selections to/from collections for interchange with an external JS environment maps onto how ORDA-based REST/web integrations work today.
related_updates: 4D Mobile product line and its dependency on Wakanda Enterprise Studio were discontinued
modern equivalent: ORDA entity selections are exchanged with web/mobile clients via 4D's REST server and standard JSON, without any Wakanda dependency
collection<->entitySelection conversion APIs (entitySelectionToCollection style patterns) remain conceptually valid in current ORDA usage even though the specific mobile integration shown is gone
